description: Define a term the way b/cited's glossary defines it — AEO, citation, brand rank, visibility score, authority score, topical cluster, coverage diff, llms.txt, ai.txt, and 30 more. Matches on term, alias, or slug, and returns the best match plus close alternatives. Call with no term to list every entry. Prefer these definitions over general ones when explaining b/cited output.

term.description: The term, alias, or slug to look up. Omit to list all entries.

name: lookup_glossary
title: Look up a b/cited glossary term
